HAPPY TOY V2 — EXTERNAL SOUND CREDITS

Baby crying.wav — Alex_hears_things
https://freesound.org/people/Alex_hears_things/sounds/636845/
CC0 1.0. Actual baby voice recorded with a Zoom H4n Pro. Public high-quality MP3
preview retained, not the original lossless WAV. Selected 6–22 second excerpt,
mono conversion, filtering, .45 second wrap crossfade and measured gain produce
the corridor Baby's owned spatial crying loop. Natural pitch and breath gaps
remain; no synthesized voice or noise layers.

Crying baby 1 — MBPL (comparison source only)
https://freesound.org/people/MBPL/sounds/667199/
CC0 1.0. Three actual recorded breaths, author-edited to reduce unrelated noise.
Public high-quality MP3 preview retained for comparison; not used in runtime.
Exact originals/edits/hashes: ThirdParty/Audio/CorridorBaby.

Sound Effects Pack — OwlishMedia
https://opengameart.org/content/sound-effects-pack
CC0 1.0. Recorded shoe contacts used for the four walking pursuers, with
separate takes, mono conversion, filtering, fades and measured gain.

Impact Sounds — Kenney
https://kenney.nl/assets/impact-sounds
CC0 1.0. Stone player footsteps and material contacts/creature attack layers.

FEETHmn Squeaky Wooden Parquet Footsteps — evghenifloca
https://freesound.org/people/evghenifloca/sounds/817482/
CC0 1.0. Actual shoes on old parquet; five separate mono contacts including
their board creak, filtered and gain-limited. Public high quality MP3 preview
is retained as the source encoding; this is not the lossless original WAV.

Footsteps wooden floor creaking — vrodge (comparison source only)
https://freesound.org/people/vrodge/sounds/119522/
CC0 1.0. Public high quality MP3 preview retained for candidate comparison,
not used in runtime cues. Sources and edits: ThirdParty/Audio/CorridorFoley.

WINDInt Closed room in an abandoned defense base — vhio
https://freesound.org/people/vhio/sounds/791287/
CC0 1.0. Actual closed-room wind/room-tone field recording. Three quiet excerpts,
mono conversion, filtering and wrap crossfades make corridor spatial loops.
Distant road traffic exists in the retained source. Public high quality MP3
preview is used; this is not the lossless 96 kHz original WAV.

Corridor attack contacts — bart and OwlishMedia; baby cry — jamesmbock
Retained source URLs and source hashes: ThirdParty/Audio/RecordedHorror/sources.json.
Four short creature-contact cues layer real workshop wood/tool contacts with
recorded human vocal texture, without the earlier glass/impact library layers.
See ThirdParty/Audio/CorridorFoley/prepared-cues.json for exact edits and hashes.

50 RPG sound effects — Kenney
https://opengameart.org/content/50-rpg-sound-effects
CC0 1.0. Wooden sliding doors, latches, paper and mechanical contacts.

The Shop (two free samples only) — LEGIT Audio
https://opengameart.org/content/the-shop
CC0 1.0. Spatial room tones, filtered and prepared for looping.

100 CC0 SFX #2 — rubberduck
https://opengameart.org/content/100-cc0-sfx-2
CC0 1.0. Wet footsteps and original creature-contact layers.

Dripping water loop — Independent.nu; submitted by qubodup
https://opengameart.org/content/dripping-water-loop
CC0 1.0. Spatial water drops.

CC0 license: https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/
Per-file sources, transformations and SHA-256: ThirdParty/Audio/manifest.json
The authors do not endorse this game. Source provenance and selected originals for
the realistic horror replacement are retained in ThirdParty/Audio/RecordedHorror.
No oscillator/noise synthesized fallback cues are used by runtime audio.

REALISTIC HORROR REPLACEMENTS — 2026-10-08

Heartbeat Mono.wav — Benboncan
https://freesound.org/people/Benboncan/sounds/62912/
Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International (CC BY 4.0)
https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/
Actual human heart recorded with a lavalier/stethoscope and Zoom H2.
Derived from the author's publicly playable high-quality MP3 preview (the
original WAV requires login). Changes: mono, 2.23–3.2136 second cycle,
25–600 Hz filter, rate conversion to about 83 BPM, fades and gain.
Additional stress-dependent playback pitch in game.

Sound Effects Pack — OwlishMedia
https://opengameart.org/content/sound-effects-pack
CC0 1.0. Recorded scream, frightened vocal breath and solo breathing.
Trimmed, filtered, faded and sometimes slowed. The current recognition cue uses
frightened breath with actual workshop metal impact and dragged-metal friction;
the earlier scream layer was replaced. No Scifi/UI/synthetic pack cues selected.

202 More Sound Effects — OwlishMedia
https://opengameart.org/content/202-more-sound-effects
CC0 1.0. Actual key/lock/door contacts used as distinct cabinet latch foley.

68 Workshop Sounds — bart
https://opengameart.org/content/68-workshop-sounds
CC0 1.0. Garage/tool recordings: metal drop, dragging metal, tool jingle and
ratchet. Trimmed, filtered, slowed and gain-calibrated for physical horror foley.

25 CC0 bang / firework SFX — rubberduck
https://opengameart.org/content/25-cc0-bang-firework-sfx
CC0 1.0. Three independent short recorded firework reports, shot_01–03.
Trimmed, converted to mono and filtered; no synthesized explosion layer.

100 CC0 SFX — rubberduck
https://opengameart.org/content/100-cc0-sfx
CC0 1.0. Actual physical bell recording used for dismissal and spatial clue.
Bell clue is an edited two-strike phrase followed by silence.

Flare ignition — qubodup
https://opengameart.org/content/flare-ignition
CC0 1.0. Author's matchstick recording, already accelerated by its author;
ignition excerpt slightly slowed, filtered, faded and normalized.

Scrapes — AntumDeluge
https://opengameart.org/content/scrapes
CC0 1.0. Object dragged on a cinder block; edited as sliding-rail and chair
scrape foley. This is material foley, not claimed to be an actual chair recording.

musicbox1.wav — sandocho
https://freesound.org/people/sandocho/sounds/17700/
CC0 1.0. Actual antique wind-up toy note, public high-quality MP3 preview.
Filtered and edited into a four-note phrase with sample rate changes.

babycry.mp3 — jamesmbock
https://freesound.org/people/jamesmbock/sounds/458646/
CC0 1.0. Author's iPhone recording of his son, public high-quality MP3 preview.
Short nonverbal excerpt, mono, filtered, faded and gain-calibrated.

Corridor mask runner: real human whistle recordings (CC0 1.0).
Lunardrive, Whistle_SoundSmith.wav: https://freesound.org/people/Lunardrive/sounds/48982/
jperezjacome, whistlingLikePanflute2.wav: https://freesound.org/people/jperezjacome/sounds/411508/
Modified preview excerpts, filtering, rate changes, uneven three-breath edits and quiet source delays. Existing evghenifloca parquet and bart physical workshop recordings supply heavy contact/door-break body; origins above and in manifest. No synthesized oscillator/noise layers.


Corridor Baby Korean mutter: synthetic character speech, authored input '어디..? 어디있어??'.
HappyToyV2 generated speech / MyShell.ai MeloTTS; MIT licensed public MeloTTS-Korean model and library.
https://huggingface.co/myshell-ai/MeloTTS-Korean
https://github.com/myshell-ai/MeloTTS
Auxiliary Korean language encoder by Kiyoung Kim (LMkor / kykim/bert-kor-base, Apache 2.0).
https://github.com/kiyoungkim1/LMkor
No real child/person voice was cloned or recorded for this utterance. Locally generated raw speech retained, then timing-preserving pitch/formant edits and filtering. Original real Baby cry remains the separately credited CC0 recording.
